title: cross-source-review convergence-record
description: The output of the convergence driver (CSR-I4) — the honest record of a same-family+different-family cross-review run on one artifact. Field NAMES are aligned to parallel-development loop_state's run-record (rounds/iterations, verdict, findings) so a Phase-B map to loop_state is cheap, but this schema has NO code dependency on loop_state. Carries the process-axis verdict (substantive_converged) and NEVER claims outcome-axis correctness (rightness stays human — cf. bc ADR field-isolation). Validated in infra/test/convergence_policy_check.py.

artifact.description: Path/ref to the artifact under review.

authority_ref.description: Optional path/ref to the authoritative reference the artifact was reviewed against (empty when self-contained).

size_tier.description: Artifact size tier; selects the cap (short=2, long=5–7).

cap.description: The max-rounds cap applied to this run (short artifact=2; long doc=5–7).

rounds.description: One entry per cross-round executed (a round = same-family pass + reconcile + different-family pass + reconcile). The count of rounds is the analog of loop_state outer.iterations.

substantive_converged.description: PROCESS-AXIS verdict. True iff (a) the core claims are coverage-verified AND (b) no new Blocker-class finding appeared for >=2 rounds. NOT outcome-axis correctness.

rightness.description: Outcome-axis constant (cf. bc field-isolation). A green process axis NEVER changes this constant — the skill does not judge whether the doc is right.

stalemate.description: True iff the cap was hit without reaching substantive convergence (NOT substantive_converged AND len(rounds) >= cap) — matches converge.py + pd ADR #40 (e). cap-hit escalates to the human, never silent-pick.

coverage.description: Honest coverage notes: what was checked, what degraded (different-family substrate-error), what was not verified. Never silent (workspace rule 3).

core_claims.description: The enumerated core claims of the artifact (the coverage-verified prong checks these were each examined). Empty when the artifact declares no explicit core-claim set.

same_source_findings.description: Count of findings from the same-family leg this round. Field name retained for schema back-compat; prose uses 'same-family'.

hetero_findings.description: Count of findings from the different-family leg this round (0 + degraded=true when the leg DEGRADED on a substrate error).

hetero_degraded.description: True iff the different-family leg DEGRADED this round (budget/turn cap, provider overwhelm — ADR #41). The same-family primary stands.

blockers.description: New BLOCKER-class findings this round (across both legs, de-duplicated). The convergence count tracks this.

verdict.description: The reconciled verdict for this round. pass = no new blocker; rewrite = new blocker(s) to fix; adversarial-stalemate = persistent disagreement (escalate to human).

findings.description: The reconciled findings this round (same-family + hetero combined per the reconciliation table; empty when the round is clean). RETENTION FIX (record-auditability): the record embeds the findings so a reader can re-judge severity — the counts-only hole is closed.

dispositions.description: One disposition per finding defect_id in this round's findings (fixed / rejected / escalated, each with the orchestrator's rationale). RETENTION FIX: 'what was done about it' is recorded, not inferred. converge.py enforces the 1:1 coverage invariant.

severity.description: blocker = real defect blocking convergence; warning = suspected/advisory (never blocks — rule 4); coverage = honest disclosure (rule 3).

kind.description: The doc-domain defect category (mirrors doc-findings.schema.json — that schema is authoritative for leg outputs; this inline copy is the record's retention shape).

location.description: Where: doc section heading, line range, or anchor id.

evidence.description: Concrete quote from the artifact (and from the source verified against, when applicable) + why it is a defect.

defect_id.description: The finding's defect_id this disposition covers (1:1 with this round's findings).

action.description: fixed = accepted, artifact revised; rejected = declined, with rationale (incl. coverage disclosures — not defects, carried in coverage notes); escalated = the reconciliation table's different-family-only→escalate row (SKILL.md step 2 — the row names no target; the skill's only named escalation target is the human).

note.description: The orchestrator's reconcile rationale — required (a disposition without a rationale is a contract violation).
